  "clinical_evidence": [{"evidence_id": "EV_001", "speaker_id": "person_1", "speaker_role": "doctor", "transcript_text": "person_1 (DOCTOR) 1.22-4.34s: hi nice to see you sit down please
person_2 (PATIENT) 6.44-9.62s: yeah thanks sorry I'm a little early

person_1 (DOCTOR) 25.29-29.07s: what's the pattern, is it there all day?

person_1 (DOCTOR) 52.26-56.20s: how would you describe it, mild, moderate, severe?
person_2 (PATIENT) 57.77-63.81s: Well, it's... hard to say, it's kind of... I don't know—
person_1 (DOCTOR) 65.13-69.95s: Take your time. Mild moderate or severe if you had to pick?
person_2 (PATIENT) 74.08-83.12s: a five out of ten I suppose i've I've had a sore throat earlier too for two days
person_1 (DOCTOR) 84.07-87.75s: How would you describe it, mild, moderate, severe?
person_2 (PATIENT) 89.23-95.62s: Well, it's... hard to say, it's kinda... I don't know—
person_1 (DOCTOR) 97.01-102.72s: take your time. Mild, moderate, or severe, if you had to pick?
person_2 (PATIENT) 104.52-106.11s: Severe, I'd say.
person_1 (DOCTOR) 107.51-110.08s: Have you had a dry cough?
person_2 (PATIENT) 111.92-113.44s: yeah, that too
person_1 (DOCTOR) 114.73-118.68s: Does it happen all the time or in spells?
person_2 (PATIENT) 120.66-133.21s: Honestly, a few times a day. Oh, I did have sharp pain in the left chest when I breathe in at one point, but that's gone now.
person_1 (DOCTOR) 134.45-141.81s: Have you had a low fever a few days ago before, or is this the first time?
person_2 (PATIENT) 143.10-148.08s: I had a similar thing last winter. It went away.
person_1 (DOCTOR) 149.88-154.31s: So did you get leg swelling or coughing up blood?
person_2 (PATIENT) 156.19-160.91s: I haven't had leg swelling or coughing up blood no.
person_1 (DOCTOR) 162.03-168.35s: have you noticed recent long travel injury to the chest or breathlessness at rest?
person_2 (PATIENT) 169.33-173.28s: Okay, so no, none of that at all.
person_1 (DOCTOR) 175.19-178.93s: anything on the skin I should know about?
person_2 (PATIENT) 183.57-185.89s: Nothing on the skin no.
person_1 (DOCTOR) 187.82-190.85s: right, is your urine normal, no changes?
person_2 (PATIENT) 191.54-193.01s: no changes there

person_2 (PATIENT) 211.02-216.02s: my sister has thyroid problems okay so my mother has migraines
person_1 (DOCTOR) 217.11-220.01s: Any diagnoses you've been given before?
person_2 (PATIENT) 221.71-225.83s: I've had diabetes for nearly five years now.
person_1 (DOCTOR) 226.37-227.30s: I see.
person_2 (PATIENT) 227.90-233.08s: I've had an irregular heartbeat for about a year now
person_1 (DOCTOR) 234.28-235.13s: okay so
person_2 (PATIENT) 236.41-239.71s: High blood pressure, for about ten years.
person_1 (DOCTOR) 240.84-244.10s: hm, okay. What's your current medication list?
person_2 (PATIENT) 245.12-252.76s: it's, It's a... um, I can't remember what it's called. It's a small white one
person_1 (DOCTOR) 253.87-256.40s: do you remember what it's for?
person_2 (PATIENT) 257.18-279.51s: yeah, for my sugar, I believe. My wife sets them out for me, I just take what I'm given. Okay, uh, so so it's telmisartan, 40 milligrams, once a day. I'm on ibuprofen, 400 milligrams, when it hurts
person_1 (DOCTOR) 280.12-283.18s: So, any operations in the past?
person_2 (PATIENT) 284.63-294.95s: yes I had a lump removed from my back years ago. A neighbour of mine said I should see someone about it
person_1 (DOCTOR) 298.73-303.78s: Are there any allergies on your record that I should check?
person_2 (PATIENT) 304.33-313.24s: yes, dust i get itchy eyes. Sulfa drugs i come out in... well, itching all over
person_1 (DOCTOR) 315.32-318.61s: A few questions about your lifestyle now.
person_2 (PATIENT) 320.06-333.24s: I stopped smoking about two years back. I gave up drinking about three years ago. I play badminton on Sundays. It's just me and my wife at home now."},
